rows.name: sky
rows.text: The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering. When sunlight reaches Earth's atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions by the gases and particles in the air. Blue light is scattered more than other colors because it travels as shorter, smaller waves, making the sky look blue to our eyes.
